subject: islamic-religious-education
general_outcomes: By the end of Senior Secondary, the learner should be able to:
develop understanding and apply the teachings of the Qur’an and Hadith for guidance,
uphold Islamic beliefs and practices, perform devotional acts to fulfil Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments for holistic human growth and sustainable use of resources,
develop positive inter-personal relationships guided by Islamic ethos for a harmonious society,
practise Islamic virtues and morals for an upright society and appreciate religious diversity for tolerance and social cohesion,
demonstrate understanding and application of Islamic law in maintenance of peace and social order in the society,
apply Islamic teachings to guide individuals to make positive contribution to social, political and economic developments in the society,

learning_experiences: • read the selected Hadith, Hadith on environment Abu Said al- Khudri (R.A.) reported that the Prophet (S.A.W.) said, “The world is sweet and green and verily Allah (S.W.) is going to install you as vicegerents in it in order to see how you act...” (Muslim) Hadith on kinship Anas Ibn Malik (R.A.) said, I heard Allah (S.W.)'s Messenger (S.A.W.) saying, “Whoever would like his provision in this world to be increased and his life span to be extended let him uphold the ties of kinship.” (Bukhari and Muslim) Hadith on brotherhood An-Nu’man ibn Bashir reported that the Prophet (S.A.W.) said, “The parable of the believers in their affection, mercy, and compassion for each other is that of a body. When any limb aches, the whole
body reacts with sleeplessness and fever.”
